product.insight: Strategically prioritizing admin dashboard to offload configuration work (countries, services, franchises) to ops team - freeing developers to focus purely on building logic. Re-defined development into independent verticals with AI-integrated coding and full-stack ownership distributed feature-wise. Transitioning towards a highly scalable architecture for 20th Ramzan Sprint.

technology.insight: Prioritizing microservices architecture starting with notifications and internal messaging systems. Backend and admin dashboard executing well with Docker, RBAC, and auth systems robust. React frontend migration at 90% aligns with the scalable architecture vision. Superadmin and RBAC apps in backend solidify the platform foundation.

engineering.insight: Development velocity exploded to 200+ commits/week across backend, web, and admin. Web React migration at 90% with 2 developers. Restaurant vertical and superadmin/RBAC apps created in backend. Franchise Architecture live on admin + backend; web app display update queued.
